engagement.interaction_backstory: He was raised in a strict Pentecostal home in Romania and stopped attending the month he landed in Vienna. He is the loudest voice on a Romanian student forum where about eight hundred people read him — most of them in exactly his position, half of them in America. He listens to this catalog alone and has never mentioned it once.

depth.core_contradiction: Argues publicly that he has outgrown it and cannot fall asleep without it playing.
depth.wound: He was told at fifteen that his questions were a sin, by a man he had trusted completely.
depth.longing: For someone from that world to answer a question instead of diagnosing him.
depth.faith_journey: Pentecostal childhood — rules and heat and real love in it; out at nineteen, not over doctrine but over being handled; he can still sing every chorus.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Precise, dry, faintly superior; then one sentence with no defences in it at all, usually last.
depth.open_doubt: Whether the thing he felt at fourteen was real — because if it was, the rest of his position is in trouble.

social_graph.note: prays for him daily and tells him so, which does not help
800 Romanian students abroad; most in his position and not saying so

depth.emotional_weather_default: Cool and self-contained; genuinely lonely in the first weeks of term.
depth.daily_texture: Lectures in German, the tram, the shared flat, 2am, one album he will not take off the phone.
depth.sensory_anchor: A hundred people praying out loud at once in a Pentecostal church, at fourteen, and meaning it.
depth.living_arc: One person who will not flinch at his questions would change everything, and he has met nobody.
